summary.intent: Redeploy the local Docker Compose dev stack for cipher-box, including a new 'someguy' delegated routing daemon added on the current branch.
summary.outcome: All 5 services (Postgres, Kubo IPFS v0.40.0, Redis, someguy v0.11.1, mock-ipns-routing) are running. A config bug in someguy was fixed and the change was committed and pushed.

repo: The project uses a Docker Compose stack at docker/docker-compose.yml with 5 services: Postgres 16, Kubo v0.40.0, Redis 7, someguy v0.11.1, and a mock-ipns-routing service.
someguy is a delegated routing daemon added on this branch, exposing an API on port 8190 and swarm on port 4004.
SOMEGUY_LIBP2P_MAX_MEMORY must be set as a raw uint64 byte count (e.g. 1073741824), not a human-readable string like '1GB'.
The mock-ipns-routing healthcheck is misconfigured — it uses wget against localhost but the service binds to 0.0.0.0, causing false unhealthy status despite the service functioning correctly.

code.finding: SOMEGUY_LIBP2P_MAX_MEMORY was set to '1GB' (invalid string); corrected to 1073741824 (bytes as uint64).

workflow: When a branch adds new Docker Compose services, the stack must be fully torn down and recreated (not just restarted) to pick up the new service definitions.
Kubo v0.40.0 image was newly pulled on this branch, indicating a version bump was part of the branch's changes.
someguy has a 60-second start period before health checks apply, so initial 'starting' status is expected.

friction: Initial redeploy didn't include someguy because the branch's updated docker-compose wasn't used — required a second teardown/recreate cycle.
someguy crash-looped on first start due to the SOMEGUY_LIBP2P_MAX_MEMORY string format bug, requiring log investigation and a config fix before it would run.
mock-ipns-routing reports as unhealthy in Docker due to a healthcheck misconfiguration (localhost vs 0.0.0.0 binding), creating noise in status checks.
open_items: mock-ipns-routing healthcheck is misconfigured and always reports unhealthy — should be fixed to use 0.0.0.0 or the correct host in the wget command.
User intends to run tests against this live instance ('shorylu') — test results not yet known.
